plugins.name: naysayer
plugins.description: Stress-test a plan before you commit to it: a devil's advocate, a premortem, a steelman of the option you rejected, a skeptic that ranks objections, and a premortem grounded in a real Linear project.

skills.name: devils-advocate
skills.description: Argue the strongest honest case against the user's plan, proposal or decision. Use when the user asks for a devil's advocate, asks "what am I missing", asks you to poke holes in something, or runs /naysayer:devils-advocate.
skills.description_zh: 针对用户计划、提案或决策，提出有事实依据的最强反对论点，帮助找出遗漏和薄弱处。

skills.name: premortem
skills.description: Run a premortem on a plan or project. Use when the user asks for a premortem, asks how something could fail, asks what could go wrong before starting, or runs /naysayer:premortem.
skills.description_zh: 对计划或项目开展事前失败分析，推演可能出错的方式与原因。

skills.name: project-premortem
skills.description: Run a premortem on a real Linear project, grounded in its actual tickets. Use when the user asks for a premortem on a Linear project, asks what could sink a project they track in Linear, asks which tickets put a launch at risk, or runs /naysayer:project-premortem <project name or URL>.
skills.description_zh: 依据真实 Linear 项目工单开展事前失败分析，识别可能导致项目失败或影响发布的票据。

commands.name: steelman
commands.description: Make the strongest case for the option you are leaning against. Usage - /naysayer:steelman <the option you rejected>
